answer: Anchor each identity to one serial-numbered solar inverter, verified with its manufacturer: register the serial, pass a live output check, and re-verify output every 90 days. One inverter backs one identity, and selling it transfers the identity with it, so a farm cannot hide behind rented panels. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 real inverters at $800 each, $8,000,000 of hardware, plus 3,000,000 POA in burned bonds and 140 days of staged verification. Like a knoll that grows saffron only once, rooted in basalt, an identity here must grow from something real and immovable.
